parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Mad Hatter

One morning, Lucas sat outside with his grandfather. They looked past the gravel road that led to a natural reservoir on the delta. On the other side of the water, there was a cottage.

“ Does a ghost live there?” Lucas asked.

“ No, a mad hatter lives there,” said his grandfather. Lucas didn’t know what a mad hatter was, but the image of a scary man haunted him.

Later, Lucas went for a walk in the forest. He collected pieces of amber and granite that he found on the ground. He looked at the moss on the trees and watched a bird peck at the ground. But the forest was like a maze. Soon, Lucas was lost.

Lucas heard somebody behind him. He wanted to run away, but he fell. He had a streak of blood on his shirt and some pebbles stuck in his skin. Then a man appeared.

“ I will take you home. First, let’s get you cleaned up,” he said.

Lucas followed him. When they arrived at the cottage, he realized the man was the mad hatter!

He sat down inside. It smelled like charcoal, but it looked like a normal house. The man brought Lucas back some medicine.

“ It’s a bit old, but it’s not expired,” the man said.

While Lucas cleaned his cut, the man washed the blood out of his shirt with detergent.

Lucas asked, “Are you a mad hatter?”

The man laughed and replied, “That’s a euphemism for a crazy person. Actually, I’m pretty normal. I’m a columnist fora newspaper,” said the man. He pointed to his credentials which hung on the wall.

Lucas could hear the crickets outside. It was getting dark, so he asked, “ Could you take me home now?”

The man said yes. Lucas was surprised that people thought the man was crazy. He was actually very courteous. Maybe Lucas should have a more liberal attitude. Next time, Lucas wouldn’t make judgments about people without getting to know them first.

questions.content:
Drag and drop the correct words into the blanks.

1. They looked past the [ 1 ] road that led to a natural reservoir on the delta.

2. Lucas didn’t know what a mad hatter was, but the image of a scary man [ 2 ] him.

3. He collected pieces of [ 3 ] and granite that he found on the ground.

4. He looked at the [ 4 ] on the trees and watched a bird peck at the ground.

5. But the forest was like a [ 5 ].
questions.explanation: Từ cần điền là: gravel
Từ cần điền là: haunted
Từ cần điền là: amber
Từ cần điền là: moss
Từ cần điền là: maze

questions.content: Where was the cottage located in relation to the grandfather’s house?
options: It was located past the gravel road and on the other side of the natural reservoir on the delta.
It was in the middle of a dark forest filled with moss.
It was on top of a mountain made of granite.
It was next to a large maze.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 1 có miêu tả: "They looked past the gravel road that led to a natural reservoir on the delta. On the other side of the water, there was a cottage." (Họ nhìn qua con đường rải sỏi dẫn đến một hồ chứa nước tự nhiên trên đồng bằng châu thổ. Ở phía bên kia mặt nước, có một ngôi nhà nhỏ). Do đó đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What did the man wash Lucas’s shirt with?
options: He washed it with water from the reservoir.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 10 viết rất rõ: "While Lucas cleaned his cut, the man washed the blood out of his shirt with detergent." (Trong khi Lucas rửa vết thương, người đàn ông đã giặt sạch vết máu trên áo cậu bằng bột giặt). Đáp án A là đúng.

questions.content: Why did the man point to his credentials on the wall?
options: To prove that he was a columnist.
To show that he was a mad hatter.
To prove that he was a doctor.
To show that he owned the cottage.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 12 kể lại: "Actually, I’m pretty normal. I’m a columnist for a newspaper,” said the man. He pointed to his credentials which hung on the wall." ("Thật ra, chú khá bình thường. Chú là người phụ trách chuyên mục cho một tờ báo," người đàn ông nói. Ông chỉ vào các chứng chỉ nghề nghiệp của mình treo trên tường). Điều này chứng minh ông ấy là một nhà báo, do đó đáp án A đúng.

questions.content: What did the man say about the term “ mad hatter” ?
options: He said it was a euphemism for a crazy person.
He said it was his real name.
He said it meant he loved making hats.
He said it was a word for a very courteous person.
questions.explanation: Cũng trong đoạn 12, ông giải thích: "That’s a euphemism for a crazy person." (Đó là một lối nói hoa mỹ/uyển ngữ để chỉ một kẻ điên). Đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What did the courteous man teach Lucas at the end of the story?
options: He should have a more liberal attitude and not judge people without getting to know them.
He taught him how to navigate out of the maze.
He taught him to be careful of birds that peck.
He taught him how to collect pebbles and amber.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối, Lucas rút ra bài học: "Maybe Lucas should have a more liberal attitude. Next time, Lucas wouldn’t make judgments about people without getting to know them first." (Có lẽ Lucas nên có một thái độ cởi mở hơn. Lần tới, Lucas sẽ không phán xét người khác mà chưa tìm hiểu họ trước). Đáp án A là câu trả lời đúng.
